Mark prospects as ready for outreach by setting outreach.ready flag and timestamps.

**Side Effects:**
- Sets outreach.ready = true
- Sets outreach.ready_at timestamp
- Sets outreach.updated_at timestamp
- Adds listTag to prospect's list_ids array
